propositions: Provider construction logic scattered across runner.py prevents uniform provider registration and makes each new provider addition require surgery to run().

ProviderSession must manage httpx.AsyncClient lifecycle by collecting closeables from builders and closing them on exit, since the provider_factory hook signature returns Provider only with no channel for resource cleanup.

Anthropic provider builder must move into providers.py as a registered factory while preserving existing retry behavior, timeouts, and proxy bypass, and existing unit tests must import _build_retrying_anthropic_model from anthropic_model instead of runner.
Unknown provider names must raise LLMConfigError with registered provider list instead of KeyError.
model_override code path must bypass the provider factory and construct no client, verifying the session closes zero resources.
